title: Colin's Patch Kit
description:
A mod for Slay the Spire 2 with [b]15 quality-of-life improvements[/b]. These patches are intended to feel like missing vanilla features.

All patches do not impact gameplay, nor competitive integrity. This mod supports the latest stable version (v0.107.1) and the latest beta version (v0.111.0), and is safe for use in multiplayer.

Please submit feedback / feature requests [url=https://github.com/colinking/sts2-patch-kit/issues]via GitHub[/url].

[h1]Installation[/h1]
Click Subscribe and restart your game.

[h1]Patches[/h1]
All patches are [b]enabled by default[/b] and can be toggled individually (Main Menu > Mod Configuration > ColinsPatchKit).

For the full list of patches (with examples), see [url=https://github.com/colinking/sts2-patch-kit#colins-patch-kit]the GitHub README[/url].

[h2]Map[/h2]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/colinking/sts2-patch-kit/main/docs/images/map-tooltip.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Current floor tooltip[/b] — Hover the current map floor to see its tooltip, not just previously visited floors.
[*][b]Upcoming floor tooltips[/b] — Hover an upcoming floor for wiki-level odds and expected rewards.
[*][b]Potion chances[/b] — Show the chance of receiving a potion on combat map tooltips.
[/list]

[h2]Combat[/h2]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/colinking/sts2-patch-kit/main/docs/images/retain-slots.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Well Laid Plans retain slots[/b] — Show one dotted card slot per card you can retain (main branch only).
[*][b]Curses & statuses first when exhausting/transforming[/b] — Sort curses, statuses, and quest cards first when picking a card to exhaust or transform.
[*][b]More active relic pulses[/b] — Pulse more relic icons while their limited effect is still available.
[*][b]Active buff/debuff pulses[/b] — Pulse buff/debuff icons that still have a limited-time effect available this turn.
[/list]

[h2]Menus[/h2]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/colinking/sts2-patch-kit/main/docs/images/random-ban.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Random character bans[/b] — Right-click to ban characters from a random pick.
[*][b]Shop affordability preview[/b] — Hovering a shop item reds out the prices you can't also afford.
[*][b]Hold to confirm leaving a rest site with Tent[/b] — Require a long-press to leave a rest site while you hold Miniature Tent.
[*][b]View Upgrades toggle[/b] — Add the deck view's "View Upgrades" toggle to the card reward screen.
[*][b]Multiplayer cards Compendium toggle[/b] — Default the Compendium's "Multiplayer cards" toggle to match your current run.
[/list]

[h2]Speed-ups[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Skip game over animations[/b] — Click to skip the slow game over score reveal.
[*][b]Move shop hand away faster[/b] — Return the merchant's pointing hand to rest faster after you stop hovering.
[*][b]Skip special card reward delay[/b] — Send special card rewards straight to your deck instead of floating them on screen.
[/list]
